Elements.Script:
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local lp = Players.LocalPlayer

local PickablesDropdown = Value:AddDropdown('Raft_Pickables', {Title = 'Select Item', Values = {'All', 'None'}, Default = 'All'})
local skipToggle = true
Value:AddToggle('Raft_SkipNearby', {Title = 'Skip Nearby Items', Default = true, Callback = function(v) skipToggle = v end})

local currentMap = {}
local debounce = false
local connections = {}

local function disconnectAll(list)
    for _, c in ipairs(list) do
        if c then
            c:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    table.clear(list)
end

local function canPivot(inst)
    return inst and (inst:IsA('Model') or inst:IsA('BasePart'))
end

local function addTarget(targets, seen, obj)
    if not canPivot(obj) then return end
    if seen[obj] then return end
    seen[obj] = true
    table.insert(targets, obj)
end

local function collectTargets()
    local targets = {}
    local seen = {}

    local pickables = workspace:FindFirstChild('Pickables')
    if pickables then
        for _, obj in ipairs(pickables:GetChildren()) do
            addTarget(targets, seen, obj)
        end
    end

    local generated = workspace:FindFirstChild('Generated')
    if generated then
        for _, inst in ipairs(generated:GetDescendants()) do
            if inst.Name == 'Pickup' then
                addTarget(targets, seen, inst.Parent)
            end
        end
    end

    return targets
end

local function itemStillExists(name)
    if not name or name == 'None' then return false end
    for _, obj in ipairs(collectTargets()) do
        if obj.Name == name then
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function refreshItems()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true

    task.spawn(function()
        task.wait(0.08)

        local names = {}
        for _, obj in ipairs(collectTargets()) do
            names[obj.Name] = true
        end

        local list = {}
        currentMap = {}
        for name in pairs(names) do
            table.insert(list, name)
            currentMap[name] = name
        end

        table.sort(list)
        table.insert(list, 1, 'All')
        if #list == 1 then
            table.insert(list, 'None')
        end

        PickablesDropdown:SetValues(list)
        debounce = false
    end)
end

local function maybeRefreshItems()
    local selected = PickablesDropdown and PickablesDropdown.Value
    if not selected or selected == 'None' then
        return
    end

    local baseName = currentMap[selected] or selected
    if not itemStillExists(baseName) then
        refreshItems()
    end
end

local function getPickupRemote()
    local rs = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')
    local remotes = rs:FindFirstChild('Remotes')
    return remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild('PickupEvent')
end

local function resolvePickupInstances(targetObj)
    local ohInstance3 = targetObj
    local ohInstance2 = targetObj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart', true)

    if not ohInstance2 then
        local descendants = targetObj:GetDescendants()
        for i = #descendants, 1, -1 do
            local d = descendants[i]
            if d:IsA('BasePart') then
                ohInstance2 = d
                break
            end
        end
    end

    if not ohInstance2 then
        local descendants = targetObj:GetDescendants()
        ohInstance2 = descendants[#descendants]
    end

    return ohInstance2, ohInstance3
end

local function bindWatchers()
    disconnectAll(connections)

    table.insert(connections, workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
        if c.Name == 'Pickables' or c.Name == 'Generated' then
            refreshItems()
            task.defer(bindWatchers)
        end
    end))

    table.insert(connections, workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(c)
        if c.Name == 'Pickables' or c.Name == 'Generated' then
            maybeRefreshItems()
            task.defer(bindWatchers)
        end
    end))

    local pickables = workspace:FindFirstChild('Pickables')
    if pickables then
        table.insert(connections, pickables.ChildAdded:Connect(refreshItems))
        table.insert(connections, pickables.ChildRemoved:Connect(maybeRefreshItems))
    end

    local generated = workspace:FindFirstChild('Generated')
    if generated then
        table.insert(connections, generated.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(inst)
            if inst.Name == 'Pickup' then
                refreshItems()
            end
        end))

        table.insert(connections, generated.DescendantRemoving:Connect(function(inst)
            if inst.Name == 'Pickup' then
                maybeRefreshItems()
            end
        end))
    end
end

local function getSelectedTargetObject(baseName, hrp)
    if not baseName or baseName == 'None' or baseName == 'All' then return nil end

    local targetObj = nil
    local minDist = math.huge

    for _, obj in ipairs(collectTargets()) do
        if obj.Name == baseName then
            local pivot = obj:GetPivot()
            local dist = (hrp.Position - pivot.Position).Magnitude
            if skipToggle and dist < 15 then
                continue
            end
            if dist < minDist then
                minDist = dist
                targetObj = obj
            end
        end
    end

    return targetObj
end

local function getAllTargetObjects(hrp)
    local out = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(collectTargets()) do
        local pivot = obj:GetPivot()
        local dist = (hrp.Position - pivot.Position).Magnitude
        if not (skipToggle and dist < 15) then
            table.insert(out, {obj = obj, dist = dist})
        end
    end

    table.sort(out, function(a, b)
        return a.dist < b.dist
    end)

    return out
end

Value:AddButton({
    Title = 'Pull Selected',
    Callback = function()
        local selected = PickablesDropdown.Value
        local baseName = currentMap[selected] or selected
        if not baseName or baseName == 'None' then return end

        local char = lp.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if not hrp then return end

        local pickupRemote = getPickupRemote()

        if baseName == 'All' then
            for _, entry in ipairs(getAllTargetObjects(hrp)) do
                local targetObj = entry.obj
                targetObj:PivotTo(hrp.CFrame)
                local ohInstance2, ohInstance3 = resolvePickupInstances(targetObj)
                if pickupRemote and ohInstance2 and ohInstance3 then
                    pcall(function()
                        pickupRemote:FireServer(true, ohInstance2, ohInstance3)
                    end)
                end
                task.wait()
            end
            return
        end

        local targetObj = getSelectedTargetObject(baseName, hrp)
        if targetObj then
            targetObj:PivotTo(hrp.CFrame)

            local ohInstance2, ohInstance3 = resolvePickupInstances(targetObj)
            if pickupRemote and ohInstance2 and ohInstance3 then
                pcall(function()
                    pickupRemote:FireServer(true, ohInstance2, ohInstance3)
                end)
            end
        end
    end
})

bindWatchers()
task.spawn(refreshItems)
